text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her all-out run in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), Kitasan Black earned the 
passionate support of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that run, Air Groove proposed 
settling things with Brusqueman at the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Satono Diamond suffered a 
narrow defeat, finishing 2nd in the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two stood together against the massive 
wall blocking their path. Next, Kitasan 
Black would take on the Takarazuka Kinen.
